div.div: Can't Take My Eyes Off You

section.div: Next Generation Server Toolkit. Create web servers with everything you need and deploy them wherever you prefer.
Extend view distance with optimized fake chunks and far-player sync.
Purpur is a drop-in replacement for Paper servers designed for configurability, and new fun and exciting gameplay features.
